name: com.reromanlee.wireframes
description: Wireframe shapes that follow Transforms through GPU skinning: lines, polylines, boxes, circles, spheres, capsules, cones and more. Create a shape once and it moves with its bones on the GPU, with no per-frame work from your code, in Play and Edit Mode, under the Built-in Render Pipeline, URP and HDRP.

samples.description: Every shape the package draws, laid out in rows: one scene creates them from code and turns their bones, another is made of shape components that draw in Edit Mode.
Spawns thousands of shapes on orbiting bones, to profile the package in your own project.
